§M{m001:Leg2:overflow=unchecked}
  §NS{ns001:Serilog.Formatting.Json:file}
    // Converts Serilog's structured property value format into JSON.
    §CL{c002:JsonValueFormatter:pub}
      §EXT{LogEventPropertyValueVisitor<TextWriter, bool>}

      §FLD{?str:_typeTagName:priv:readonly}
      §FLD{str:DefaultTypeTagName:priv:const} = "_typeTag"

      §CTOR{ctor003:pub}
        §I{?str:typeTagName} = DefaultTypeTagName
        §ASSIGN _typeTagName typeTagName

      // Format value as JSON to output.
      // @param value — The value to format
      // @param output — The output
      §MT{m004:Format:pub} (LogEventPropertyValue:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{Visit} §A output §A value §/C

      // Visit a ScalarValue value.
      // @param state — Operation state.
      // @param scalar — The value to visit.
      // @returns The result of visiting scalar.
      // @throws ArgumentNullException — When scalar is null
      §MT{m005:VisitScalarValue:prot:over} (TextWriter:state, ScalarValue:scalar) -> bool
        §C{Guard.AgainstNull} scalar
        §C{FormatLiteralValue} §A scalar.Value §A state §/C
        §R false

      // Visit a SequenceValue value.
      // @param state — Operation state.
      // @param sequence — The value to visit.
      // @returns The result of visiting sequence.
      // @throws ArgumentNullException — When sequence is null
      §MT{m006:VisitSequenceValue:prot:over} (TextWriter:state, SequenceValue:sequence) -> bool
        §C{Guard.AgainstNull} sequence
        §C{state.Write} §A '[' §/C
        §B{~delim:?char} null
        §IF{scope013} true
          §B{~i} 0
          §B{~_forFirst007:bool} true
          §WH{while012} true
            §IF{if008} _forFirst007
              §ASSIGN _forFirst007 false
            §EL
              §ASSIGN i (+ i 1)
            §IF{if009} (< i sequence.Elements.Count)
            §EL
              §BK
            §IF{body011} true
              §IF{if010} (!= delim null)
                §C{state.Write} delim.Value
              §ASSIGN delim ','
              §C{Visit} §A state §A §IDX sequence.Elements i §/C
        §C{state.Write} §A ']' §/C
        §R false

      // Visit a StructureValue value.
      // @param state — Operation state.
      // @param structure — The value to visit.
      // @returns The result of visiting structure.
      §MT{m014:VisitStructureValue:prot:over} (TextWriter:state, StructureValue:structure) -> bool
        §C{state.Write} §A '{' §/C
        §B{~delim:?char} null
        §IF{scope021} true
          §B{~i} 0
          §B{~_forFirst015:bool} true
          §WH{while020} true
            §IF{if016} _forFirst015
              §ASSIGN _forFirst015 false
            §EL
              §ASSIGN i (+ i 1)
            §IF{if017} (< i structure.Properties.Count)
            §EL
              §BK
            §IF{body019} true
              §IF{if018} (!= delim null)
                §C{state.Write} delim.Value
              §ASSIGN delim ','
              §B{prop} §IDX structure.Properties i
              §C{WriteQuotedJsonString} §A prop.Name §A state §/C
              §C{state.Write} §A ':' §/C
              §C{Visit} §A state §A prop.Value §/C
        §IF{if022} (&& (!= _typeTagName null) (!= structure.TypeTag null))
          §C{state.Write} delim
          §C{WriteQuotedJsonString} §A _typeTagName §A state §/C
          §C{state.Write} §A ':' §/C
          §C{WriteQuotedJsonString} §A structure.TypeTag §A state §/C
        §C{state.Write} §A '}' §/C
        §R false

      // Visit a DictionaryValue value.
      // @param state — Operation state.
      // @param dictionary — The value to visit.
      // @returns The result of visiting dictionary.
      §MT{m023:VisitDictionaryValue:prot:over} (TextWriter:state, DictionaryValue:dictionary) -> bool
        §C{state.Write} §A '{' §/C
        §B{~delim:?char} null
        §EACH{each024:element:var} dictionary.Elements
          §IF{if025} (!= delim null)
            §C{state.Write} delim.Value
          §ASSIGN delim ','
          §C{WriteQuotedJsonString} §A (str (?? element.Key.Value "null")) §A state §/C
          §C{state.Write} §A ':' §/C
          §C{Visit} §A state §A element.Value §/C
        §C{state.Write} §A '}' §/C
        §R false

      // Write a literal as a single JSON value, e.g. as a number or string. Override to support more value types. Don't write arrays/structures through this method - the active destructuring policies have already indicated the value should be scalar at this point.
      // @param value — The value to write.
      // @param output — The output
      §MT{m026:FormatLiteralValue:prot:virt} (?any:value, TextWriter:output)
        §IF{if027} (== value null)
          §C{FormatNullValue} output
          §R
        §IF{if028} (is value str)
          §B{str:str} (cast str value)
          §C{FormatStringValue} §A str §A output §/C
          §R
        §IF{if029} (is value ValueType)
          §IF{if030} (is value i32)
            §B{i32:i} (cast i32 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A i §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if031} (is value u32)
            §B{u32:ui} (cast u32 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A ui §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if032} (is value i64)
            §B{i64:l} (cast i64 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A l §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if033} (is value u64)
            §B{u64:ul} (cast u64 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A ul §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if034} (is value dec)
            §B{dec:dc} (cast dec value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A dc §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if035} (is value u8)
            §B{u8:bt} (cast u8 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A bt §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if036} (is value i8)
            §B{i8:sb} (cast i8 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A sb §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if037} (is value i16)
            §B{i16:s} (cast i16 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A s §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if038} (is value u16)
            §B{u16:us} (cast u16 value)
            §C{FormatExactNumericValue} §A us §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if039} (is value f64)
            §B{f64:d} (cast f64 value)
            §C{FormatDoubleValue} §A d §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if040} (is value f32)
            §B{f32:f} (cast f32 value)
            §C{FormatFloatValue} §A f §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if041} (is value bool)
            §B{bool:b} (cast bool value)
            §C{FormatBooleanValue} §A b §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if042} (is value char)
            §C{FormatStringValue} §A (str value) §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if043} (is value datetime)
            §B{datetime:dt} (cast datetime value)
            §C{FormatDateTimeValue} §A dt §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if044} (is value datetimeoffset)
            §B{datetimeoffset:dto} (cast datetimeoffset value)
            §C{FormatDateTimeOffsetValue} §A dto §A output §/C
            §R
          §IF{if045} (is value timespan)
            §B{timespan:timeSpan} (cast timespan value)
            §C{FormatTimeSpanValue} §A timeSpan §A output §/C
            §R
        §C{FormatLiteralObjectValue} §A value §A output §/C

      §MT{m046:FormatBooleanValue:priv:stat} (bool:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} (? value "true" "false")

      §MT{m047:FormatFloatValue:priv:stat} (f32:value, TextWriter:output)
        §B{_preCondition049} (|| §C{float.IsNaN} §A value §/C §C{float.IsInfinity} §A value §/C)
        §IF{if048} _preCondition049
          §C{FormatStringValue} §A §C{value.ToString} §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C §A output §/C
          §R
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A "R" §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m050:FormatDoubleValue:priv:stat} (f64:value, TextWriter:output)
        §B{_preCondition052} (|| §C{double.IsNaN} §A value §/C §C{double.IsInfinity} §A value §/C)
        §IF{if051} _preCondition052
          §C{FormatStringValue} §A §C{value.ToString} §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C §A output §/C
          §R
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A "R" §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m053:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (i32:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m054:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (u32:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m055:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (i64:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m056:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (u64:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m057:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (dec:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m058:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (u8:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m059:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (i8:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m060:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (i16:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m061:FormatExactNumericValue:priv:stat} (u16:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A null §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C

      §MT{m062:FormatDateTimeValue:priv:stat} (datetime:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A "O" §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C

      §MT{m063:FormatDateTimeOffsetValue:priv:stat} (datetimeoffset:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C
        §C{output.Write} §C{value.ToString} §A "O" §A CultureInfo.InvariantCulture §/C
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C

      §MT{m064:FormatTimeSpanValue:priv:stat} (timespan:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C
        §C{output.Write} (str value)
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C

      §MT{m065:FormatLiteralObjectValue:priv:stat} (any:value, TextWriter:output)
        §C{Guard.AgainstNull} value
        §C{FormatStringValue} §A (?? (str value) "") §A output §/C

      §MT{m066:FormatStringValue:priv:stat} (str:str, TextWriter:output)
        §C{WriteQuotedJsonString} §A str §A output §/C

      §MT{m067:FormatNullValue:priv:stat} (TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} "null"

      // Write a valid JSON string literal, escaping as necessary.
      // @param str — The string value to write.
      // @param output — The output.
      §MT{m068:WriteQuotedJsonString:pub:stat} (str:str, TextWriter:output)
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C
        §B{~cleanSegmentStart} 0
        §B{~anyEscaped} false
        §IF{scope077} true
          §B{~i} 0
          §B{~_forFirst069:bool} true
          §WH{while076} true
            §IF{if070} _forFirst069
              §ASSIGN _forFirst069 false
            §EL
              §ASSIGN i (+ i 1)
            §IF{if071} (< i (len str))
            §EL
              §BK
            §IF{body075} true
              §B{c} §IDX{str} i
              §IF{if072} (|| (|| (< c (char-from-code 32)) (== c '\\')) (== c '"'))
                §ASSIGN anyEscaped true
                §C{output.Write} (substr str cleanSegmentStart (- i cleanSegmentStart))
                §ASSIGN cleanSegmentStart (+ i 1)
                §B{_castInt074} (char-code c)
                §W{match073} c
                  §K '"'
                    §C{output.Write} "\\\""
                  §/K
                  §K '\\'
                    §C{output.Write} "\\\\"
                  §/K
                  §K '\n'
                    §C{output.Write} "\\n"
                  §/K
                  §K '\r'
                    §C{output.Write} "\\r"
                  §/K
                  §K '\f'
                    §C{output.Write} "\\f"
                  §/K
                  §K '\t'
                    §C{output.Write} "\\t"
                  §/K
                  §K _
                    §C{output.Write} "\\u"
                    §C{output.Write} §C{_castInt074.ToString} §A "X4" §/C
                  §/K
        §IF{if078} anyEscaped
          §IF{if079} (!= cleanSegmentStart (len str))
            §C{output.Write} (substr str cleanSegmentStart)
        §EL
          §C{output.Write} str
        §C{output.Write} §A '"' §/C
